hunks.baseline: Unstoppable in every direction.
hunks.sol: Ranging unchecked in every direction.

hunks.baseline: That was me now. Wherever my eyes could see and my hands could reach, I cut, stabbed, and smashed without restraint. Every time the spearhead flashed, blood spurted, and flesh and bone split apart.
hunks.sol: That was me now. Wherever I looked, whatever came within reach, I cut, stabbed, and smashed my way through it. Every flash of my spearhead sent blood spraying and split flesh from bone.

hunks.baseline: I moved freely among the enormous ogres without the slightest hindrance.
hunks.sol: I moved freely among the enormous ogres with nothing to stop me.

hunks.baseline: With a death rattle, the three-meter-tall body dropped to its knees.
hunks.sol: With a death rattle, the three-meter-tall hulk dropped to its knees.

hunks.baseline: The last time I had applied points was during my duel with Chulwoo.
hunks.sol: The last time I had assigned points was during my duel with Chulwoo.

hunks.baseline: But opening my Conception and Governor Vessels had pushed my control and explosive power over my internal energy, along with my senses, to an extreme level.
hunks.sol: But opening my Conception and Governor Vessels had pushed my control and explosive power over my internal energy—as well as my senses—to an entirely new level.

hunks.baseline: Even when the ogres’ iron clubs, packed with immense force, came crashing down from every direction, they looked unbelievably slow.
hunks.sol: Even when the ogres’ iron clubs came crashing down from every direction with tremendous force, they looked unbelievably slow.

hunks.baseline: The ogres in my eyes were nothing more than idiots who had no idea how to use their strength properly.
hunks.sol: To me, the ogres were nothing but idiots who had no idea how to use their own strength.

hunks.baseline: Another ogre, one of countless by now, dropped to its knees with a wet, blood-choked rattle.
hunks.sol: Another ogre—I'd lost count by now—dropped to its knees with a wet, blood-choked rattle.

hunks.sol: Its furry hand reached for the spearhead piercing straight through its Adam’s apple, then went limp and fell away.

hunks.baseline: I had already leveled up.
hunks.sol: I’d leveled up already.

hunks.baseline: The rate at which I was sucking up EXP while clearing them out by myself was no joke.
hunks.sol: Clearing them out by myself was raking in EXP at an insane rate.

hunks.baseline: *Is it because every one of these bastards is higher-level than me?*
hunks.sol: *Is it because every last one of these bastards is higher-level than me?*

hunks.baseline: My current Level was somewhere in the mid-to-high seventies, so I was five to ten Levels below the ogres.
hunks.sol: My current Level was somewhere in the mid-to-high seventies, putting the ogres anywhere from five to ten Levels above me.

hunks.baseline: Since I was slicing them up like pork shoulder at a butcher shop, it was only natural that my Level would rise quickly.
hunks.sol: And since I was slicing through them like slabs of pork shoulder at a butcher shop, it was only natural that my Level would rise quickly.

hunks.baseline: The EXP was far more generous than I had expected.
hunks.sol: The EXP was far more generous than I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: A thought suddenly flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: A thought flashed through my mind.

hunks.baseline: I gazed at the Gate, which continued to churn and spit out ogres, my eyes shining.
hunks.sol: Eyes shining, I stared at the Gate as it churned and spat out another ogre.

hunks.baseline: This was completely…
hunks.sol: This place was practically…

hunks.baseline: *This is a popular restaurant.*
hunks.sol: *The hottest restaurant in town.*

hunks.baseline: The Gate kept spitting out EXP—or rather, monsters—and I kept killing them. If that continued steadily, then…
hunks.sol: The Gate kept spitting out EXP—or rather, monsters—and I kept killing them. If that cycle continued…

hunks.baseline: *So this was where the conveyor-belt sushi place was.*
hunks.sol: *So this is where the conveyor-belt sushi place was hiding.*

hunks.baseline: The EXP I got from the ogres was sweeter than tuna belly.
hunks.sol: The EXP from the ogres was sweeter than tuna belly.

hunks.baseline: My mouth curved upward as I imagined chewing every ogre that came out and digesting it into points.
hunks.sol: My mouth curled into a grin at the thought of chewing up every ogre that came out and digesting them into points.

hunks.baseline: —Descend!
hunks.sol: —Drop!

hunks.baseline: Three or four combat helicopters flew in with the roar of fierce winds, circled overhead, and then dropped around twenty Hunters like lightning.
hunks.sol: Three or four combat helicopters flew in on a blast of wind and circled overhead. Around twenty Hunters dropped from them like bolts of lightning.

hunks.baseline: They were falling from a height of more than twenty meters. At that height, even Hunters outfitted with magical Equipment were bound to strain their knees on landing.
hunks.sol: They were falling from a height of more than twenty meters. From that high up, even Hunters equipped with magical Equipment were bound to strain their knees on landing.

hunks.baseline: But these weren’t the incompetent amateurs who had been here before I arrived.
hunks.sol: But these newcomers weren’t the incompetent amateurs who had been here before I arrived.

hunks.baseline: With the mage’s incantation, a ripple of energy passed through the air.
hunks.sol: At the mage’s incantation, a ripple of mana passed through the air.

hunks.baseline: The bodies that had been plunging downward quickly and violently began to slow.
The ogres, which had been about to swing their iron clubs, hesitated after missing their timing. Then the second spell was cast.
hunks.sol: The bodies plunging rapidly toward the ground began to slow. The ogres about to swing their iron clubs hesitated when their timing was thrown off, and then the second spell activated.

hunks.baseline: The four remaining ogres lost their balance. Some staggered, while others collapsed onto the ground.
hunks.sol: The four remaining ogres lost their balance. Some staggered, while others collapsed to the ground.

hunks.baseline: At the shout, the spell slowing their descent was dispelled, and the melee fighters shot forward like streaks of light.
hunks.sol: At the shout, the spell slowing the Hunters’ descent was released, and the melee fighters shot forward like streaks of light.

hunks.baseline: The ogres let out low growls, sensing their imminent deaths.
hunks.sol: The ogres let out low growls as they sensed their imminent deaths.

hunks.baseline: The Hunters who had just been about to drive their weapons into the ogres’ chests stared at me with baffled expressions.
hunks.sol: The Hunters who had been about to plunge their weapons into the ogres’ chests stared at me in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: The captain slowly looked around.
hunks.sol: The captain slowly surveyed the area.

hunks.baseline: The tollgate had collapsed so completely that it was impossible to recognize its original shape. Monster blood was scattered across the half-destroyed road.
hunks.sol: The tollgate had collapsed so completely that its original shape was unrecognizable, and monster blood lay splattered across the half-destroyed road.

hunks.baseline: Soldiers and Hunters had different statuses, but both were registered with the government as members of military support teams.
hunks.sol: Soldiers and Hunters had different roles, but both were registered with the government as members of military support teams.

hunks.baseline: “So far, four dead and five with severe injuries. We’ll know more once we finish checking.”
hunks.sol: “So far, four dead and five severely injured. We’ll know more once we finish checking.”

hunks.baseline: “Four dead and five with severe injuries.”
hunks.sol: “Four dead and five severely injured.”

hunks.baseline: The captain repeated the figures calmly before continuing.
hunks.sol: The captain calmly repeated the figures, then continued.

hunks.baseline: “This is the second Gate occurrence today.”
hunks.sol: “This is already the second Gate occurrence today.”

hunks.baseline: “Tell me about it. An F-rank Gate erupted near Yangju City about an hour ago. I don’t know if something serious is going on.”
hunks.sol: “Tell me about it. An F-rank Gate erupted in the Yangju area about an hour ago. I’m starting to wonder if something serious is happening.”

hunks.baseline: “An F-rank Gate that appeared in the town center, or a B-rank Gate that appeared in the middle of a road packed with commuters. Which one looks more serious?”
hunks.sol: “An F-rank Gate opening in town, or a B-rank Gate opening in the middle of a road packed with commuters. Which one sounds more serious?”

hunks.baseline: “But there were more casualties on the F-rank Gate side. Ten dead and more than twenty with severe injuries.”
hunks.sol: “But the F-rank Gate caused more casualties. Ten dead and more than twenty severely injured.”

hunks.baseline: “Downplaying it. Covering it up. After two years, you should be getting a feel for what kind of place this is.”
hunks.sol: “They downplayed it. Covered it up. You’ve been doing this for two years. You should know how things work around here by now.”

hunks.baseline: “From our perspective, a hundred bows wouldn’t be enough to thank him. He’s a civilian hero who stopped a major catastrophe all by himself.”
hunks.sol: “As far as we’re concerned, a hundred bows wouldn’t be enough to thank him. He’s a civilian hero who single-handedly prevented a catastrophe.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, no, that’s not what I meant. I mean he’s an insanely strong crazy person. He killed more than ten ogres by himself, so he must be an A-rank Hunter or something.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, no, that’s not what I meant. I mean he’s insanely strong *and* crazy. He killed more than ten ogres by himself, so he must be an A-rank Hunter or something.”

hunks.baseline: The Team Leader turned toward the place the captain indicated and immediately scowled.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Jeong followed the captain’s gaze and immediately scowled.

hunks.baseline: A skinny, middle-aged man carrying an expensive camera was approaching them with an excited stride.
hunks.sol: A skinny, middle-aged man carrying an expensive camera was approaching with an excited spring in his step.

hunks.baseline: The Hunter Team Leader replied with a deeply displeased expression.
hunks.sol: The Hunter Team Leader replied with open displeasure.

hunks.sol: “You’re only part of the team at times like this, huh? The rest of the time, you’re a military correspondent. You’re usually drowning in a hangover, and now you’re beside yourself just because you landed a scoop.”

hunks.sol: The reporter flinched, and the captain stepped in.

hunks.sol: “That’s enough. And Reporter Kim, please be more mindful in the future. This is an accident scene. Running around by yourself in high spirits because you found a scoop doesn’t look good.”

hunks.baseline: “…Ahem. I’ll be more careful from now on.”
hunks.sol: “…Ahem. I’ll be more careful.”

hunks.baseline: Even as he answered, the reporter’s eyes sparkled with anticipation.

hunks.sol: If a typhoon was going to strike the Korean Peninsula, people could at least predict when and how it would arrive and which areas might be damaged. There was no predicting where or when a Gate would form.

hunks.sol: *Two Gates in one day was already unprecedented, and one of them was even B-rank.*

hunks.sol: A tollgate security team helplessly overrun, followed by the heroic arrival of an unknown Hunter who prevented a rush-hour catastrophe!

hunks.sol: “So where’s our hero? He’s an A-rank Hunter, right? What’s his name? A fresh new face would sell better for a story like this.”

hunks.baseline: “He’s over there. The new face.”
hunks.sol: “He’s over there. Your new face.”

hunks.sol: No matter how much he looked around, there was no sign of a hero clad in gleaming armor.

hunks.sol: The reporter’s eyes swept across the area before suddenly stopping.

hunks.sol: “There, Team Leader Jeong. Is that him? In front of the ogre corpse…”

hunks.sol: “You might be once you’re in tomorrow’s newspaper.”

hunks.sol: “You know the Capital Defense Command, right? I’m the military correspondent assigned to Support Team 25.”

hunks.sol: “Given the field I cover, I know nearly every A-rank Hunter. But…”
